description: Deterministic baseline benchmark dataset for KIP v1.0. Questions are designed to be answerable from the provided sample document. All results at this version are Baseline / Not Yet Evaluated with a live LLM.

cases.question: What is the name of the AI platform described in this document?
What vector database does KIP use for storing embeddings?
Which document formats does KIP support for ingestion?
How are chunk IDs generated to ensure idempotency?
cases.reference_answer: Using SHA-256 hash of the document ID and chunk index

cases.question: What happens when a query finds no relevant context?
cases.reference_answer: The system returns a predefined empty-context message
